purpose: Define the paired Linhe validation inputs needed before Paper12 can be assessed as an ArcGIS or Esri-reference replacement candidate.
non_goals: Do not create or infer manual labels.
Do not run ArcGIS or Esri services.
Do not upgrade the ArcGIS replacement claim without paired evidence.
column_rule: Each row must include sample_id plus either a mask path or a scalar label for manual, ArcGIS, and Paper12 evidence.
path_resolution: Mask paths are resolved relative to the manifest CSV location.
supported_mask_formats: raster masks when rasterio is installed
next_actions: Run scripts/prepare_arcgis_replacement_validation_packet.py to prepare a conservative annotation packet from Linhe patch and Esri mask indexes.

Run scripts/audit_arcgis_replacement_validation_packet.py --min-candidate-rows 30 on the packet directory to inspect missing evidence and sample-size readiness before and after annotation or prediction export.
Manually annotate the packet samples and save masks to the manifest target paths.
Run scripts/export_paper12_packet_predictions.py with a Paper12 checkpoint to save checkpoint-backed masks to the packet target paths.

Run scripts/finalize_arcgis_replacement_validation_packet.py --min-candidate-rows 30 on the packet directory to create an evaluator-ready manifest only when all evidence exists and shapes match while recording sample-size readiness.
Run scripts/evaluate_arcgis_replacement.py on the finalizer output with --bootstrap-iterations 1000 --min-candidate-rows 30 before changing decision_status.

decision_rule.not_validated: Use when required paired evidence is missing.
decision_rule.partial: Use when paired evidence exists but Paper12 is below ArcGIS beyond tolerance on mIoU or any critical class.
decision_rule.replacement_candidate: Use only when Paper12 matches or exceeds ArcGIS within tolerance on mIoU and all critical classes.
decision_rule.insufficient_sample_size: Use when paired outputs exist but the evaluator has fewer than the minimum manifest rows required for a replacement-candidate decision.
decision_rule.insufficient_class_coverage: Use when paired outputs exist but independent manual labels do not cover every required critical class.

coverage_diagnostics.critical_class_support: valid manual pixels or scalar labels per critical class
coverage_diagnostics.critical_class_row_support: manifest rows containing each critical class after ignore-index filtering
